# `st_geogfromwkb`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Parses the WKB description of a geography and returns the corresponding GEOGRAPHY value.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 4.1 and later.

## Syntax

```text
st_geogfromwkb(wkb)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `st_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.1.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.1 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- st_geogfromwkb, example 1
> SELECT hex(st_asbinary(st_geogfromwkb(X'0101000000000000000000F03F0000000000000040')));
0101000000000000000000F03F0000000000000040
```
